name: comp-23
title: Password Visibility Toggle
blurb: Password input that toggles between masked and visible text.
description: A password field with an eye icon button that toggles between password and text input types. Tracks visibility state with useState.
use_when: Users need to verify their typed password before submitting a login or signup form.
avoid_when: You need to support paste-based passwords or accessibility requirements that disallow unmasked passwords.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-pressed, aria-label (dynamic), and aria-controls. Icons marked aria-hidden.
